executor: human, on the G4/Colab machine, after or alongside the G4 systems validation
do_not_redesign: Primary statistics and outcome bands below are predeclared. If a metric is changed after seeing results, it must be reported as exploratory and the predeclared value must still be published.

corpus.verify: index digest always; per-file SHA-256 unless --fast-verify is passed

checkpoint.maturing_comparison: run step2000 and latest with identical sampling if the first run reproduces E3-A/B; report the ordering of conditional gap, global concentration and band structure across the two

sampling.design: stream 8 corpus batches x GLOBAL_BATCH=64 packed rows (512 windows, 1,048,576 tokens) at start_sequence=0; microbatch 8 rows
sampling.sampled_per_batch: 2 chunks x 128 tokens per row for per-token statistics; all tokens for population mass/counts
sampling.context_strata: T=2048 (native, tag v1), T=1024 (tag ctx1024), T=512 (tag ctx512): truncated windows, same start_sequence; T>2048 is a separate length-extrapolation experiment, not ordinary evaluation
sampling.position_strata: document-relative position bins and sequence-position quartiles are predeclared in the analyzer
sampling.corpus_region_strata: repeat the census at start_sequence=1,000,000 if the first run completes cheaply; otherwise document as untested

A_delta_u_64.definition: per-token fraction of u=x*y mass in the token's own top-64 coordinates minus the fraction captured by a cross-fitted frozen global top-64 ranking; mean over 32 (level,head) cells

B_topn_curves.definition: local and global top-N mass curves for N=16..4096 per key x,y,u, pooled over heads; report delta(N) with document-block bootstrap CIs

C_core_ladder.definition: cross-fitted global mass-top core at 1/3.125/6.25/12.5/25% of K; per-token core mass fraction, core active rate, residual coordinates for 50/80/90% of the residual, and total active width for 90% of u mass

D_content_stability.definition: (i) same-document lag curve 1..127 (top-64 Jaccard, support Jaccard, Spearman, RBO) vs cross-document control; (ii) long-range same-document bins inter_128_256, inter_256_512, inter_512_plus from the two sampled chunks (sampler extended for this contract); (iii) level-0 x excluded from interpretation (token identity)
D_content_stability.E2_synthetic_reference: random-token lag1 top-64 Jaccard u=0.133 vs cross 0.097 (ratio 1.37); repeated-content probe u=0.542/0.466/0.404 at lags 256/512/1024 vs matched shuffled 0.096/0.092/0.089

outcome_support.E3-A: same-doc lag1/cross ratio >= 1.5 OR a long-range bin exceeds cross-doc by >= 0.05
outcome_support.E3-B: same-doc > cross-doc but below the A threshold

E_frequency_band.definition: per-(level,head) 16-band mass-share non-uniformity and frequency trend vs a pair-preserving permutation null (5000 draws, RoPE pairs kept intact); pooled x and per-cell z values
E_frequency_band.E2_reference: x pooled max-share z=+13.2, 32/32 cells z>3; u pooled z=+0.26, 12/32 cells; canonical init z=-0.2

outcome_support.E3-A: >= 24/32 x cells z>3 and pooled z>5

secondary_quantities: Delta_x(16) and Delta_x(1024); x local/global ladder
Gini, N_eff/K, participation ratio of global coordinate mass
zero fractions x/y/u and pair zero fractions
document-level between-vs-within variance of the conditional gap
cross-checkpoint global ranking overlap (step2000 vs latest)

nulls_and_controls.conditionality: cross-fitted global top-N ranking (ranking from the other batch split)
nulls_and_controls.stability: cross-document pairs as the unrelated-context control
nulls_and_controls.units: document/block bootstrap; tokens are not independent replicates

final_outcome_rule.must_report: B, C, D, E support bands and any position/context stratum that contradicts the primary label
final_outcome_rule.accepted_outcomes: E3-A strong reproduction, E3-B partial reproduction (magnitude shift), E3-C synthetic result fails on natural text; all three are scientifically acceptable
